label: 鲸鸿动能 Petal Ads (Huawei Ads)
terms_note: Complete Huawei Developer Alliance real-name authentication, request a client ID, apply for Marketing API permissions, then OAuth 2.0 login → access_token (refreshable). Rate limits: not specified on the page. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Huawei Developer client id; login → access_token + refresh_token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Petal Ads Marketing API) Confidence: **high** — official Huawei doc page read (WebFetch).
auth: 1. Real-name authentication in the Huawei Developer Alliance; request a client ID.
2. Apply for Marketing API permissions for the Petal Ads account.
3. OAuth 2.0: '登录并获取access_token' → bearer token, '刷新access_token' with the refresh token; then '获取用户信息'.

reference.limits: - Rate limits not specified on the page. Access by Huawei Developer verification + permission approval. Free API.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Your Marketing API client ID (华为开发者联盟 → 申请客户端ID).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The client secret shown for that client ID in the developer alliance.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from the authorization-code login (authorize with access_type=offline and the ads scopes, then exchange the code at /oauth2/v2/token), see ads_api09.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: Advertiser ID; required when the authorizing Huawei ID is a manager (经理) account, a service-provider account or linked to several sub-client advertisers.

me.note: Refreshes the access token and reads the first page of campaigns: verifies the authorization and Marketing API permission.

list_accounts.note: GET openapi/v2/manager/advertiser/query: the advertiser accounts under a manager (经理) account authorization (page_size 10–50). Advertiser ids are 18-digit integers above 2^53: the Python server returns them exactly, the TypeScript server's JSON parser may round the last digits.

list_campaigns.note: GET openapi/v2/promotion/campaign/query?advertiser_id&page_num&page_size (the documented query-parameter form; the new /ads/v1/promotion/campaign/query takes a JSON body on GET, which is not sent). page_size must be 10–50. `status` is a show_status value such as CAMPAIGN_STATUS_DELIVERY_OK (【计划界面显示的状态】).

get_report.note: POST openapi/v2/reports/campaign/query per day and campaign (time_granularity DAILY, group_by CAMPAIGN_ID + DATE), filtered to campaign_id when given: impressions (show_count), clicks, cost (CNY), cpc and download/install/activation counts; up to 1,000 rows. stat_datetime is YYYYMMDDHH. Contract (合约) data is not included.

update_budget.note: POST /ads/v1/promotion/campaign/update {campaign_id, daily_budget: {daily_budget, daily_budget_op_type: UPDATE_TODAY_DAILY_BUDGET}}: today's campaign daily limit, a whole number of CNY that must differ from the current value (see 修改限额约束). `currency` is not applied.

adapter.terms: 鲸鸿动能 (Petal Ads) Marketing API: developer real-name verification, a client ID and Marketing API permission for the advertiser, manager or service-provider account are required (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/promotion/ads_api02-0000001058566534). Responses carry code "200" (queries) or 200 (edits) on success; other codes are errors (e.g. 1000009992 token expired).
